quest.title: Alright, Iaune, Alright
quest.description: Iaune is in the café, sighing...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* I don't know why this happened...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Oh, Traveler, nice to meet you. Are you here for some coffee? I'll treat you to a cup.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What's wrong? You look terrible. Has someone been forcing you to stay up late again?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Thanks for your concern. However, this is my own issue this time.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I've been thinking... About the meaning of my work.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I've always believed the Maison Gestion to be a just, efficient, strong organization in which everyone is willing to help each other.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I believe that under its management, the Court of Fontaine would see itself develop positively.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: But the way I see it now, it is a ruined mechanical house. Its gears, levers, and apertures are being pulled chaotically... Only its facade remains pristine.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: It only operates because of a series of coincidences and lessons, not precise consideration or design.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I... I want to do something about it, but I can't. I fear that one mistake on my part will send this house tumbling down.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Roialte always tells me to relax a bit, since my mistakes cannot make things worse than they already are...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Th—That's an odd way of comforting someone...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: *sigh* Sorry, I shouldn't complain. I came out here to get away from all that for a while, after all...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'll make you a cup of coffee.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Really? You know how to brew coffee? That's amazing — I've always wanted to learn, but I can never find the time.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I'll leave it to you, then. I'll wait here... and with any luck, work won't catch up with me at the café.

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Traveler, have you come to help us out? You're most welcome!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No, no, we're just here to help a friend make some coffee. He's just... Well...

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: By "a friend," do you mean Iaune — you know, the fellow sitting over there?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You know him?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Roialte and I are old friends. He mentioned that a bright, hardworking fellow came to their office recently, and that's Iaune.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Don't you worry too much about him — young people who've just started at the Maison Gestion will always find themselves a little dejected at first.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: They'll be fine once they find a place for themselves there.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You sound very experienced. Why's that?

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Well, I was once a radish planted in the field that is the Maison Gestion, too.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: But I wasn't satisfied with being a mere radish, and so I left my lot and... opened this café some time later.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Hahaha, perhaps! But nowadays, I'm just a café owner.

response.speaker: Arouet
response.text: Alright, weren't you going to make Iaune a cup of coffee? I'll go adjust the device — come find me once you're ready.

choices.text: Sounds like a real trove of stories to be told...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: I've prepared all the needed ingredients. They're over there, so you can start brewing any time.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What should we put into the coffee this time?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sounds great! Time to start blending, then!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, that smells good! Now let's hand it to Iaune. Paimon sure hopes it cheers him up!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Traveler... You really made me that cup of coffee? Um, I... Sorry for troubling you...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: This coffee... It's way better than the stuff provided at the Maison Gestion! In fact, it's in a whole different dimension...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: If this was the coffee I drank every day, I wouldn't spend so much time teetering on the brink of sleep.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Thanks for the coffee. I'll head back to work once I finish it.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I will. I need to grow into my work as soon as possible and stand on my own two feet like Roialte does.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: *sigh* I just wonder how many nightmares I'll have to endure before then...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Well? Ready to make Iaune his cup of coffee?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've got other matters to attend to at the moment...

dialogues.speaker: Arouet
dialogues.text: Make your preparations, then come find me.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: A mechanical house... Will I eventually become a broken gear within it someday?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The ingredients are added. The Traveler's Special Blend is complete.
